title: The Duet of Kettle and Cups
youtube_title: The Duet of Kettle and Cups | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Asking for a second pair of hands is a skill.
summary: At a cottage room with a long tablecloth and paper stars, a kettle and a tray of cups that had to arrive together will go wrong if one person rushes. Isla and Kei split it into two slow jobs, while the baker only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
